---
title: "HORECA Competition Report"
format: typst
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{python}
#| output: asis
import json

with open("report_data.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

print(f"**Address:** {data['address']}\n")
print(f"**Category:** {data['category']}\n")
print(f"**Search radius:** {data['radius']} m\n")
print(f"**Total venues found within {data['radius']} m:** {data['total_count']}\n")

closest = data.get("closest_distance")
if closest is not None:
    print(f"**Closest matching venue:** {closest} m\n")
else:
    print("**Closest matching venue:** none found\n")
```

## Competition assessment

```{python}
#| output: asis
competition = data.get("competition") or {}
print(f"**{competition.get('level', 'N/A')}**\n")

nearby_note = competition.get("nearby_note")
if nearby_note:
    print(f"\n{nearby_note}\n")
```

## Closest establishments

```{python}
#| output: asis
results = data.get("results") or []

if results:
    print("| Name | Type | Website | Distance (m) |")
    print("|---|---|---|---|")
    for v in results:
        website = v.get("website") or "—"
        print(f"| {v['name']} | {v['type']} | {website} | {v['distance']} |")
else:
    print("No venues found within the search radius.\n")
```

## Limitations

OpenStreetMap metadata can be incomplete or out of date. These results must
be validated with local field research before any real business decision.
